title: Published response count omits field reduction
note: The 49,023-gate multiplier exactly matches the cited unreduced Karatsuba polynomial circuit. Production requires GCM modular reduction, so 17,648,280 gates and depth 11,352 are a nonlinear subtotal rather than a complete exact scalar response construction or valid upper frontier. An explicit 508-CNOT serial reduction schedule demonstrates the omitted work; no replacement frontier is claimed.
